properties.description: Detects 3 or more different successful sensitive Okta actions by the same account and IP within 5 minutes.
properties.query:
let Sensitive = materialize(
    OktaV2_CL
    | where EventOriginalType in (
        "user.account.privilege.grant",
        "system.api_token.create",
        "user.mfa.factor.deactivate",
        "user.mfa.factor.reset_all",
        "user.mfa.factor.update"
    )
    | where EventResult == "Success"
    | project TimeGenerated, OriginalEventTime, ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr, EventOriginalType
);
Sensitive
| project ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr, WindowStart = OriginalEventTime
| join kind=inner (Sensitive) on ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr
| where OriginalEventTime >= WindowStart
    and OriginalEventTime <= WindowStart + 5m
| summarize
    TotalActions = count(),
    UniqueActions = dcount(EventOriginalType),
    FirstAction = min(OriginalEventTime),
    LastAction = max(OriginalEventTime),
    TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated)
    by ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr, WindowStart
| where UniqueActions >= 3
| summarize arg_max(TotalActions, *) by ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUsername, SrcIpAddr, TotalActions, UniqueActions, FirstAction, LastAction
